caseName: Thornburgh v. American College of Obstetricians & Gynecologists
caseNameFull: Thornburgh, Governor of Pennsylvania v. American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists

opinions.text: C. A. 3d Cir. [Probable jurisdiction postponed, 471 U. S. 1014.] Motion of Alan Ernest to allow counsel to represent children unborn and born alive denied. Motion of Legal Defense Fund for Unborn Children for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae denied. Motion of the Acting Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae, for divided argument, and for additional time for oral argument denied.
